codename: Internal Browser, Audio Amplification & Neural Feed Evolution
title: Internal Browser, Audio Amplification & Neural Feed Evolution
label: Internal Alpha
summary: This update introduces a native persistent browser for seamless internal redirects, enhances audio detection via digital frame amplification, and significantly overhauls the Neural Feed UI to support future complex multi-step AI interactions.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Engineered a persistent, independent in-app web browser with multi-tab navigation, URL support, and dynamic secure icon rendering.
Added secure internal URL redirection handling to display links natively without breaking ecosystem immersion.
Introduced a dedicated background wallpaper and a structured header bar to the Neural Feed for a polished, tactical appearance.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Upgraded Wake Word and Ear Core sensitivity via digital amplification of raw audio frames to accurately process quieter commands.
Overhauled Neural Feed UI to dynamically format errors, chat history, tool execution messages, and complex multi-step responses.
Implemented console color coding: Cyan for LLM context text and Yellow for Gemini configurations and System Prompts.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Resolved a critical state-change error within the Visar_Chat_Core Persona Selector, ensuring seamless dynamic personality switching.

sections.title: Removed & Deprecated
items: Purged dead code and stripped unwanted, redundant logic from Visar_Edge_Brain to improve execution speed and maintainability.

notes: This minor release establishes essential UI and sensory foundations for upcoming agentic tasks. By integrating a native browser and vastly improving audio frame sensitivity, VISAR Edge is now equipped to seamlessly navigate web contexts and capture nuanced environmental audio data without compromising processing speed.
